Samuel.title: Samuel
Samuel.question: Will a listener speak truth when people demand the wrong kind of power?

chapters.title: The Voice at Night
chapters.game: Listen three times and answer correctly.

chapters.title: A Hard Message
chapters.game: Tell Eli the whole message without embellishment.

chapters.title: The Ark Captured
chapters.game: Track the cost of treating the Ark like a charm.

chapters.title: Ebenezer
chapters.game: Raise a memorial stone after deliverance.

chapters.title: A King Demanded
chapters.game: Hear the elders and explain the tradeoffs.

chapters.title: Saul’s First Victory
chapters.game: Rally the people and refuse revenge.

chapters.title: David Anointed
chapters.game: Look past height and choose the shepherd son.
